title: ID0385740-DC/Si-D/FI-[udABVw] - Dispenser door "open"
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Yesterday 21.10.2024 door was open, after site visit everything were ok but now after night, the door is open again.
Yesterday Sakari drove to the site since charger was OoO and we had door open error message even though nobody has been there for a long time. When I arrived the door was closed but little loose. I moved the locks little bit deeper in the charger and made sure all 3 locks were latched.
Today the same door is open again
Root cause: Faulty door switch
Solution: switch replaced
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:
